Excellent product for wheeling our big drums safely, even over crack in the concrete. Ver stable.
Exactlly as advertised. Solid construction. Good materials.

Welds are a bit messy and seem to not be done that well, so maybe review the welds before putting something closer to the weight limit. But for my use it works well enough since I am not putting much weight on it. Just leaving this review so others can check the welds before using to it's limit The wheels also were an issue, when rotated they would hit the connecting nuts. Customer service advised me to flip the bolt around (even though it was installed correctly) but this would cause a safety risk as the bolt could shear. I ended up buying different castor wheels and new bolts.

I bought this brush for our hunting cabin. We used it last weekend and it was fabulous. The way it cleaned inside the chimney and the interconnecting poles are a great product. Our cabin is seasonal so I see this product lasting us a very long time.

Works great. The rods are very flexible but have a nice thickness to them. As a previous pellet and wood stove tech who used to use professional equipment, I would choose this kit over the other stuff any day.
Water barrier works perfectly to control water direction or as a flood barrier. I used 2 layers which gave me @ an 8” barrier. Easy to apply. Price was literally 1/4 the price at the major box stores
